result.feeChargedOn: payout to provider only; 0 on reject/refund
result.evaluatorFeeChargedOn: provider gross on settled Complete/Partial when the verdict stands; 0 on reject, overturn, instant release
result.arbitrationFeeModel: challenger pays bond + quoted arbitration cost; both held by the contract until the ruling; on a ruling the cost goes to the arbitrator and the losing side reimburses it if the ruling is material; on a stale dispute both are refunded to the challenger

erc8183Adapter.minKernelExpiryRule: kernel job expiredAt >= assign/accept time + evalWindow + challengeWindow + arbitrationTimeout + expiryMargin; assign and acceptAssignment revert ExpiryTooSoon otherwise

token.note: Circle test USDC on Base Sepolia (testnet, no value); proxy contract, codeHash is of the proxy

evaluatorAdapter.kind: ERC8183EvaluatorAdapter (staked evaluator for external ERC-8183 kernels)

fees.chargedOn: provider payout (settlement or instant release); 0 on reject or refund
fees.evaluatorFeeChargedOn: provider gross on settled Complete/Partial when the verdict stands
fees.arbitrationFeeModel: challenger pays bond + quoted arbitration cost; both held by the contract until the ruling; on a ruling the cost goes to the arbitrator and the losing side reimburses it if the ruling is material; on a stale dispute both are refunded to the challenger
